title: jacobaea vulgaris subsp. dunensis
intro: Jacobaea vulgaris subsp. dunensis, commonly known as Dun Marsh Cudweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family, Asteraceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Dun Marsh Cudweed are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
